```{r}
#|label: load the rvest package

library(rvest)
```

```{r}
#|label: v2 of recipe and baking directions scraper function - added URL as a parameter that can be changed - From chapter 20

scrape_recipes <- function(URL) {
  
  ## Read html structure of the web page
  brownies <- read_html(URL)
  
  # Steps to get ingredients data
  ## STEP 1. Get html nodes using CSS selector
  ingredients <- html_nodes(brownies, ".mm-recipes-structured-ingredients__list")
  
  ## STEP 2. Load the data as a text
  ingredients <- html_text(ingredients)
  
  ## STEP 3. Remove extra spaces
  ingredients <- trimws(ingredients)
  
  ## STEP 4. Remove \n characters from the vector
  ingredients <- gsub("\n\n\n", " ", ingredients)

  ## STEP 5. Split at measurement patterns
  ingredients <- gsub("\\s+(\\d+\\s+tablespoons?)\\s+", "\n\\1 ", ingredients)
  ingredients <- gsub("\\s+(\\d+\\s+½\\s+cups?)\\s+", "\n\\1 ", ingredients)
  ingredients <- gsub("\\s+(\\d+\\s+large)\\s+", "\n\\1 ", ingredients)
  ingredients <- gsub("\\s+(½\\s+teaspoon)\\s+", "\n\\1 ", ingredients)
  ingredients <- gsub("\\s+(⅔\\s+cup)\\s+", "\n\\1 ", ingredients)
  ingredients <- gsub("\\s+(¼\\s+teaspoon)\\s+", "\n\\1 ", ingredients)
  
  ## STEP 6. Split vector elements using newline
  ingredients <- strsplit(ingredients, "\n")[[1]]
  
  ## STEP 7. Display ingredients in better format
  for(i in 1: length(ingredients)) {
    cat(i, ".", ingredients[i], "\n")
  }
  
  
  # Steps to get directions data
  
  ## STEP 1. Get directions for baking
  directions <- html_nodes(brownies, '#mntl-sc-block_1-0')
  
  # STEP 2. Express the format of the scraped data for baking directions - text
  directions <- html_text(directions)
  
  # STEP 3. Remove image caption
  directions <- gsub("Dotdash Meredith Food Studios", "", directions, ignore.case = TRUE)
  
  # STEP 4. Remove excessive newlines and spaces
  directions <- gsub("\\n+", " ", directions) # Replace newlines with spaces
  direction <- gsub("\\s+", " ", directions)  # Replace multiple spaces with single
  directions <- trimws(directions)            # Remove leading/trailing spaces
  
  # STEP5. Split only at major cooking action words
  
  major_cooking_actions <- c("Gather", "Preheat", "Combine sugar", "Bake", "Let cool")
  action_pattern <- paste0("(?<=\\.)\\s+(?=",
                           paste(major_cooking_actions, collapse = "|"), ")")
  
  steps <- strsplit(directions, action_pattern, perl = TRUE)[[1]]
  
  # STEP 5. Clean and filter steps
  steps <- trimws(steps)
  
  # STEP 6. Keep only meaningful steps
  steps <- steps[nchar(steps) > 15]
  
  # STEP 7. Add the word Step and step numbers
  directions <- paste0("Step ", 1:length(steps), ": ", steps)
  
  # STEP 8. Display results in a clean, tidy format
  for(i in 1:length(directions)) {
    cat(directions[i], "\n\n")
  }
}
```

## 21.1 Basic for loops

```{r}
#|label: simple example of for loop

for (i in 1:10) {
  print(i)
}
```

-   The basic concept of a for loop is that you have some code that you need to run many times with slight changes to a value or values in the code - somewhat like a function.

```{r}
#|label: call different variable inside for loop

for (a_number in 1:10) {
  print(a_number)
}
```

```{r}
#|label: variables can take other types

animals <- c("cat", "dog", "gorilla", "buffalo", "lion", "snake")

for (animal in animals) {
  print(animal)
}
```

```{r}
#|label: more complicated example of for loop

for (a_number in 1:10) {
  print(a_number + 2)
}
```

```{r}
#|label: change each element of a vector using for loop

numbers <- 1:10

for (i in 1:length(numbers)) {
  numbers[i] <- numbers[i] + 2
}
```

```{r}
#|label: see the result of change

numbers
```

```{r}
#|label: example function - add 2 to the given number

add_2 <- function(number) {
  number <- number + 2
  return(number)
}
```

```{r}
#|label: use the function inside a for loop

for (i in 1:length(numbers)) {
  numbers[i] <- add_2(numbers[i])
}
```

```{r}
#|label: check the result of the for loop and function

numbers
```

## 21.2 Scraping multiple recipes

```{r}
#|label: recipe links vector

recipe_urls <- c("https://www.allrecipes.com/recipe/25080/mmmmm-brownies/",
                 "https://www.allrecipes.com/recipe/27188/crepes/",
                 "https://www.allrecipes.com/recipe/22180/waffles-i/")
```

```{r}
#|label: v3 of recipe and baking directions scraper function - CSS selectors as parameters

scrape_recipes <- function(URL, 
                          ingredients_selector = ".mm-recipes-structured-ingredients__list",
                          directions_selector = "#mntl-sc-block_1-0") {
  
  ## Read html structure of the web page
  page <- read_html(URL)
  
  # ============================================================================
  # INGREDIENTS SECTION
  # ============================================================================
  
  ## STEP 1. Get html nodes using CSS selector
  ingredients <- html_nodes(page, ingredients_selector)
  
  ## STEP 2. Load the data as a text
  ingredients <- html_text(ingredients)
  
  ## STEP 3. Remove extra spaces
  ingredients <- trimws(ingredients)
  
  ## STEP 4. Remove \n characters from the vector
  ingredients <- gsub("\n\n\n", " ", ingredients)
  
  ## STEP 4.5. Additional cleaning for concatenated ingredients
  if (directions_selector == "#mm-recipes-steps_1-0") {
    if (grepl("crepes", URL, ignore.case = TRUE)) {
      # Handle specific crepes patterns that might be concatenated
      ingredients <- gsub("(\\d+\\s+large\\s+eggs?)\\s+(\\d+\\s+½\\s+teaspoons?)", "\\1\n\\2", ingredients)
      ingredients <- gsub("(teaspoons?\\s+[^\\n]+?)\\s+(\\d+\\s+pinch)", "\\1\n\\2", ingredients)
      ingredients <- gsub("(oil,?\\s+divided)\\s+(\\d+\\s+pinch)", "\\1\n\\2", ingredients)
    } else if (grepl("waffles", URL, ignore.case = TRUE)) {
      # Handle waffles patterns - more complex concatenations
      ingredients <- gsub("(\\d+\\s+large\\s+eggs?)\\s+(\\d+\\s+cups?)", "\\1\n\\2", ingredients)
      ingredients <- gsub("(cups?\\s+all-purpose\\s+flour)\\s+(\\d+\\s*¾?\\s+cups?)", "\\1\n\\2", ingredients)
      ingredients <- gsub("(cups?\\s+milk)\\s+(½\\s+cup)", "\\1\n\\2", ingredients)
      ingredients <- gsub("(cup\\s+vegetable\\s+oil)\\s+(\\d+\\s+tablespoons?)", "\\1\n\\2", ingredients)
      ingredients <- gsub("(tablespoons?\\s+[^\\n]+?)\\s+(\\d+\\s+teaspoons?)", "\\1\n\\2", ingredients)
      ingredients <- gsub("(teaspoons?\\s+baking\\s+powder)\\s+(¼\\s+teaspoon)", "\\1\n\\2", ingredients)
      ingredients <- gsub("(teaspoon\\s+salt)\\s+(½\\s+teaspoon)", "\\1\n\\2", ingredients)
      ingredients <- gsub("(teaspoon\\s+vanilla\\s+extract)\\s+(nonstick)", "\\1\n\\2", ingredients)
    }
  }
  
  ## STEP 5. Split at measurement patterns based on ingredients selector
  if (ingredients_selector == ".mm-recipes-structured-ingredients__list") {
    # Brownies-specific patterns (original selector)
    ingredients <- gsub("\\s+(\\d+\\s+tablespoons?)\\s+", "\n\\1 ", ingredients)
    ingredients <- gsub("\\s+(\\d+\\s+½\\s+cups?)\\s+", "\n\\1 ", ingredients)
    ingredients <- gsub("\\s+(\\d+\\s+large)\\s+", "\n\\1 ", ingredients)
    ingredients <- gsub("\\s+(½\\s+teaspoon)\\s+", "\n\\1 ", ingredients)
    ingredients <- gsub("\\s+(⅔\\s+cup)\\s+", "\n\\1 ", ingredients)
    ingredients <- gsub("\\s+(¼\\s+teaspoon)\\s+", "\n\\1 ", ingredients)
    
  } else if (ingredients_selector == ".mntl-structured-ingredients__list" || 
             directions_selector == "#mm-recipes-steps_1-0") {
    # Alternative AllRecipes format - check URL to determine specific patterns
    if (grepl("crepes", URL, ignore.case = TRUE)) {
      # Crepes-specific patterns
      ingredients <- gsub("\\s+(\\d+\\s+cups?)\\s+", "\n\\1 ", ingredients)
      ingredients <- gsub("\\s+(\\d+\\s+eggs?)\\s+", "\n\\1 ", ingredients)
      ingredients <- gsub("\\s+(\\d+\\s+large\\s+eggs?)\\s+", "\n\\1 ", ingredients)
      ingredients <- gsub("\\s+(\\d+\\s+½\\s+teaspoons?)\\s+", "\n\\1 ", ingredients)
      ingredients <- gsub("\\s+(\\d+\\s+tablespoons?)\\s+", "\n\\1 ", ingredients)
      ingredients <- gsub("\\s+(½\\s+teaspoon)\\s+", "\n\\1 ", ingredients)
      ingredients <- gsub("\\s+(¼\\s+teaspoon)\\s+", "\n\\1 ", ingredients)
      ingredients <- gsub("\\s+(1¼\\s+cups?)\\s+", "\n\\1 ", ingredients)
      ingredients <- gsub("\\s+(⅔\\s+cup)\\s+", "\n\\1 ", ingredients)
      ingredients <- gsub("\\s+(⅓\\s+cup)\\s+", "\n\\1 ", ingredients)
      ingredients <- gsub("\\s+(1\\s+pinch)\\s+", "\n\\1 ", ingredients)
    } else if (grepl("waffles", URL, ignore.case = TRUE)) {
      # Waffles-specific patterns
      ingredients <- gsub("\\s+(\\d+\\s+large\\s+eggs?)\\s+", "\n\\1 ", ingredients)
      ingredients <- gsub("\\s+(\\d+\\s+cups?)\\s+", "\n\\1 ", ingredients)
      ingredients <- gsub("\\s+(1\\s*¾\\s+cups?)\\s+", "\n\\1 ", ingredients)
      ingredients <- gsub("\\s+(½\\s+cup)\\s+", "\n\\1 ", ingredients)
      ingredients <- gsub("\\s+(\\d+\\s+tablespoons?)\\s+", "\n\\1 ", ingredients)
      ingredients <- gsub("\\s+(\\d+\\s+teaspoons?)\\s+", "\n\\1 ", ingredients)
      ingredients <- gsub("\\s+(½\\s+teaspoon)\\s+", "\n\\1 ", ingredients)
      ingredients <- gsub("\\s+(¼\\s+teaspoon)\\s+", "\n\\1 ", ingredients)
      ingredients <- gsub("\\s+(nonstick)\\s+", "\n\\1 ", ingredients)
    } else {
      # General patterns
      ingredients <- gsub("\\s+(\\d+\\s+cups?)\\s+", "\n\\1 ", ingredients)
      ingredients <- gsub("\\s+(\\d+\\s+eggs?)\\s+", "\n\\1 ", ingredients)
      ingredients <- gsub("\\s+(\\d+\\s+tablespoons?)\\s+", "\n\\1 ", ingredients)
      ingredients <- gsub("\\s+(½\\s+teaspoon)\\s+", "\n\\1 ", ingredients)
      ingredients <- gsub("\\s+(¼\\s+teaspoon)\\s+", "\n\\1 ", ingredients)
      ingredients <- gsub("\\s+(1¼\\s+cups?)\\s+", "\n\\1 ", ingredients)
      ingredients <- gsub("\\s+(⅔\\s+cup)\\s+", "\n\\1 ", ingredients)
      ingredients <- gsub("\\s+(⅓\\s+cup)\\s+", "\n\\1 ", ingredients)
    }
    
  } else if (ingredients_selector == ".recipe-ingredients li" || 
             ingredients_selector == ".ingredients li" ||
             grepl("waffles", URL, ignore.case = TRUE)) {
    # List-based ingredients format - waffles patterns
    ingredients <- gsub("\\s+(\\d+\\s+large\\s+eggs?)\\s+", "\n\\1 ", ingredients)
    ingredients <- gsub("\\s+(\\d+\\s+cups?)\\s+", "\n\\1 ", ingredients)
    ingredients <- gsub("\\s+(1\\s*¾\\s+cups?)\\s+", "\n\\1 ", ingredients)
    ingredients <- gsub("\\s+(½\\s+cup)\\s+", "\n\\1 ", ingredients)
    ingredients <- gsub("\\s+(\\d+\\s+tablespoons?)\\s+", "\n\\1 ", ingredients)
    ingredients <- gsub("\\s+(\\d+\\s+teaspoons?)\\s+", "\n\\1 ", ingredients)
    ingredients <- gsub("\\s+(½\\s+teaspoon)\\s+", "\n\\1 ", ingredients)
    ingredients <- gsub("\\s+(¼\\s+teaspoon)\\s+", "\n\\1 ", ingredients)
    ingredients <- gsub("\\s+(nonstick)\\s+", "\n\\1 ", ingredients)
    
  } else {
    # General patterns for any other selector
    ingredients <- gsub("\\s+(\\d+(?:\\.\\d+)?\\s+(?:cups?|tablespoons?|teaspoons?|ounces?|pounds?))\\s+", "\n\\1 ", ingredients)
    ingredients <- gsub("\\s+(½|¼|¾|⅓|⅔|1½|2½|3½)\\s+(cups?|tablespoons?|teaspoons?)\\s+", "\n\\1 \\2 ", ingredients)
    ingredients <- gsub("\\s+(\\d+\\s+(?:large|medium|small))\\s+", "\n\\1 ", ingredients)
    ingredients <- gsub("\\s+(\\d+(?:\\.\\d+)?\\s+(?:large|medium|small))\\s+", "\n\\1 ", ingredients)
  }
  
  ## STEP 6. Check if ingredients were found and split vector elements using newline
  if (length(ingredients) == 0 || ingredients == "" || is.na(ingredients)) {
    cat("=== INGREDIENTS ===\n")
    cat("⚠️  No ingredients found with selector:", ingredients_selector, "\n")
    cat("Try using the find_recipe_selectors() function to find the correct selector.\n")
    ingredients <- character(0)
  } else {
    ingredients <- strsplit(ingredients, "\n")[[1]]
    
    ## STEP 7. Clean up empty entries
    ingredients <- ingredients[ingredients != "" & nchar(trimws(ingredients)) > 0]
    
    ## STEP 8. Display ingredients in better format
    cat("=== INGREDIENTS ===\n")
    if (length(ingredients) > 0) {
      for(i in 1:length(ingredients)) {
        cat(i, ".", ingredients[i], "\n")
      }
    } else {
      cat("⚠️  No ingredients could be parsed. Check the selector or page structure.\n")
    }
  }
  
  # ============================================================================
  # DIRECTIONS SECTION  
  # ============================================================================
  
  ## STEP 1. Get directions for baking
  directions <- html_nodes(page, directions_selector)
  
  # Check if directions were found
  if (length(directions) == 0) {
    cat("\n=== DIRECTIONS ===\n")
    cat("⚠️  No directions found with selector:", directions_selector, "\n")
    cat("Try using the find_recipe_selectors() function to find the correct selector.\n")
    directions <- character(0)
    steps <- character(0)
  } else {
    # STEP 2. Express the format of the scraped data for baking directions - text
    directions <- html_text(directions)
    
    # Check if directions text is empty
    if (length(directions) == 0 || all(directions == "") || all(is.na(directions))) {
      cat("\n=== DIRECTIONS ===\n")
      cat("⚠️  No directions text could be extracted. Check the selector or page structure.\n")
      directions <- character(0)
      steps <- character(0)
    } else {
  
      # STEP 3. Remove image captions and common unwanted text
      directions <- gsub("Dotdash Meredith Food Studios", "", directions, ignore.case = TRUE)
      directions <- gsub("Allrecipes", "", directions, ignore.case = TRUE)
      directions <- gsub("Photo by", "", directions, ignore.case = TRUE)
      directions <- gsub("^Directions\\s+", "", directions, ignore.case = TRUE)  # Remove "Directions" at start
      directions <- gsub("Diana Chistruga", "", directions, ignore.case = TRUE)  # Remove photographer credit
      directions <- gsub("/\\s*Diana Chistruga", "", directions, ignore.case = TRUE)  # Remove with slash
      
      # STEP 4. Remove excessive newlines and spaces
      directions <- gsub("\\n+", " ", directions) # Replace newlines with spaces
      directions <- gsub("\\s+", " ", directions)  # Replace multiple spaces with single
      directions <- trimws(directions)            # Remove leading/trailing spaces
      
      # STEP 4.5. For waffles, also split on forward slashes which seem to separate steps
      if (grepl("waffles", URL, ignore.case = TRUE)) {
        directions <- gsub("\\s*/\\s*", "|||SPLIT|||", directions)  # Replace / with split marker
      }
      
      # STEP 5. Split based on directions selector and cooking actions
      if (directions_selector == "#mntl-sc-block_1-0") {
        # Original brownies selector - brownies actions
        major_cooking_actions <- c("Gather", "Preheat", "Combine sugar", "Bake", "Let cool")
        
      } else if (directions_selector == "#mm-recipes-steps_1-0") {
        # Same selector used for both crepes and waffles - check URL
        if (grepl("crepes", URL, ignore.case = TRUE)) {
          # Crepes specific - only split at major step breaks
          major_cooking_actions <- c("Heat a skillet")
        } else if (grepl("waffles", URL, ignore.case = TRUE)) {
          # Waffles specific - split at major cooking transitions
          major_cooking_actions <- c("Whisk eggs", "Spray the preheated waffle iron", "Serve and enjoy")
        } else {
          # Default for this selector
          major_cooking_actions <- c("Heat", "Cook", "Serve")
        }
        
      } else if (directions_selector == "#mntl-sc-block_3-0" ||
                 grepl("waffles", URL, ignore.case = TRUE)) {
        # Waffles specific selector - split at major cooking transitions
        major_cooking_actions <- c("Whisk eggs", "Spray the preheated waffle iron", "Serve and enjoy")
        
      } else if (grepl("instructions", directions_selector, ignore.case = TRUE) || 
                 grepl("directions", directions_selector, ignore.case = TRUE)) {
        # Instructions/directions based selectors
        major_cooking_actions <- c("Gather", "Preheat", "Mix", "Combine", "Whisk", "Beat", 
                                  "Heat", "Cook", "Bake", "Pour", "Add", "Stir", "Let cool", "Serve")
      } else {
        # General cooking actions for any other selector
        major_cooking_actions <- c("Gather", "Preheat", "Mix", "Combine", "Whisk", "Beat", 
                                  "Heat", "Cook", "Bake", "Pour", "Add", "Stir", "Let cool", "Serve")
      }
      
      # Create pattern for splitting
      if (grepl("waffles", URL, ignore.case = TRUE)) {
        # For waffles, split on our custom marker
        steps <- strsplit(directions, "\\|\\|\\|SPLIT\\|\\|\\|")[[1]]
      } else {
        # For other recipes, use the cooking actions pattern
        action_pattern <- paste0("(?<=\\.)\\s+(?=", paste(major_cooking_actions, collapse = "|"), ")")
        steps <- strsplit(directions, action_pattern, perl = TRUE)[[1]]
      }
      
      # STEP 6. Clean and filter steps
      steps <- trimws(steps)
      
      # STEP 7. Keep only meaningful steps (longer than 15 characters)
      steps <- steps[nchar(steps) > 15]
      
      # STEP 8. Add the word Step and step numbers
      if (length(steps) > 0) {
        directions_formatted <- paste0("Step ", 1:length(steps), ": ", steps)
        
        # STEP 9. Display results in a clean, tidy format
        cat("\n=== DIRECTIONS ===\n")
        for(i in 1:length(directions_formatted)) {
          cat(directions_formatted[i], "\n\n")
        }
      } else {
        cat("\n=== DIRECTIONS ===\n")
        cat("⚠️  No meaningful direction steps could be parsed.\n")
      }
    }
  }
  
  # Return the data as a list (optional)
  invisible(list(
    ingredients = if(exists("ingredients")) ingredients else character(0),
    directions = if(exists("steps")) steps else character(0),
    ingredients_selector = ingredients_selector,
    directions_selector = directions_selector,
    url = URL
  ))
}
```


```{r}
               ingredients_selector = ".mm-recipes-structured-ingredients__list",
               directions_selector = "#mm-recipes-steps_1-0")
```
